1  THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL IS FILED UNDER  SECTION 173(1) OF MV ACT, 1987, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND  AWARD DATED 26.08.2013 PASSED IN MVC NO.782/2012 ON THE  FILE OF THE IV-ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE AND  MEMBER, MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, BELAGAVI, PATRLY  ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING  ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.
 THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL, COMING ON FOR  ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:804  MFA No. 100458 of 2016  JUDGMENT
Though the matter is listed for admission, with the consent of the parties, matter is taken up for final disposal.
2. Claimant is in appeal challenging the quantum of compensation awarded in MVC No.782/2012 dated 26.08.2013 on the file of IV Addl. District and Sessions Judge & MACT, Belgaum.

entities.text: Addl. District and Sessions Judge & MACT, Belgaum
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Facts which have been established in the case on hand is that the appellant-claimant sustained accidental injuries on 07.09.2011 in respect of road traffic accident involving Bajaj Pulsor Motor Cycle bearing No.KA-23/Y-7006.
Tribunal after considering the written statement contentions and material evidence on record allowed the petition in part granting compensation in a sum of Rs.2,08,400/-.
4. Being not satisfied with the quantum of compensation, claimant is in appeal.

5. Reiterating the grounds urged in the appeal memorandum, learned counsel Smt.Shruthi sought for NC: 2024:KHC-D:804 enhancement of compensation by contending that on all heads the tribunal has granted compensation on lower side.

6. Per contra, learned counsel Sri.R.R.Mane supported the impugned judgment by contending that the principal of law prevailing at the time of passing the award with regard to awarding of compensation has been followed by the tribunal and tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation and sought for dismissal of the appeal.
7. On rival contentions of the parties, this court has perused the material available on record meticulously involving all the rulings.

8. On such perusal of the material on record, it is crystal clear that on the head of pain and suffering and loss of amenities and future medical expenses and loss of nourishment, Tribunal has granted Abubakar S/O Sardarsab Kadapi vs Babajan Dastagir Shaikh on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/160169552/
2 compensation on the lower side.

entities.text: Abubakar S/O Sardarsab Kadapi vs Babajan Dastagir Shaikh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: So also, under the head loss of earning during laid up period needs to be reworked.

9. Instead of enhancement of compensation on each and every head, if the compensation awarded by the tribunal is NC: 2024:KHC-D:804 globally enhanced by another sum of Rs.70,000/-, ends of justice would be met.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER i) Appeal is allowed.

ii) As against compensation of Rs.2,08,400/-
awarded by the tribunal, claimant is entitled for a sum of Rs.2,78,4000/- with interest at 6% per annum from the date of petition till its realization.
iii) Balance compensation amount is to be deposited by the insurance company within four weeks from today.
